gbm_population_evidence.quote: Omental Tissue Autograft in Human Recurrent Glioblastoma Multiforme (rGBM)
Subject has a histologically confirmed (frozen section) diagnosis of recurrent WHO Grade IV glioblastoma multiforme (GBM).

candidate_evidence.quote: Laparoscopically harvested omental tissue autograft: 1. Standard neurosurgical removal of recurrent GBM,

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: implanted into the resection cavity of recurrent glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) patients.

coder_notes: Surgical procedure (autologous omental tissue graft) only; no drug or biologic interventions. Phase NA. Glioblastoma multiforme terminology = historical. Some conditions list malignant/high-grade glioma but inclusion requires recurrent GBM.
